title: Python dependency missing
symptoms: ModuleNotFoundError No module named ImportError package missing module cannot import package pip dependency virtual environment
cause: The required package may not be installed in the Python environment running the application, the import name may differ from the distribution name, or the intended virtual environment may not be active.
fix: Check which Python executable runs the program; activate the intended virtual environment; install the package using python -m pip install package-name; verify the import name and requirements file; restart the application. Avoid installing packages blindly into a global environment.

title: Python indentation error
symptoms: IndentationError expected an indented block unexpected indent mixed tabs spaces if for while def class
cause: Python uses indentation to define code blocks. A block may be empty or its indentation may be inconsistent.
fix: Inspect the line named in the traceback and the preceding block opener; indent the block consistently, preferably using four spaces; check for mixed tabs and spaces; run a syntax check before rerunning.

title: Java NullPointerException
symptoms: java.lang.NullPointerException object is null dereference method call field access
cause: Code attempted to access a method or field through a null reference. The stack trace points to the location of the access, not necessarily where the value first became null.
fix: Inspect the exact stack-trace line; identify the receiver of the failing call; trace where it is assigned; validate input and object lifecycle; use a clear guard or correct initialization where appropriate. Avoid adding a broad catch that hides the cause.

title: API key or authentication error
symptoms: HTTP 401 Unauthorized invalid API key authentication failed token missing API provider
cause: The credential may be invalid, revoked, copied incorrectly, or not being read from the expected environment/configuration. Some services also use different credentials for different environments.
fix: Check the provider dashboard and exact environment variable or secret setting; rotate exposed keys; remove whitespace; confirm the key has not been revoked and the account has access. Never print or commit the key while debugging.

title: SQL relation or table not found
symptoms: SQLSTATE relation does not exist table not found unknown table invalid object schema database
cause: The table name may be misspelled, the query may use the wrong schema/database, migrations may not have run, or identifier casing may differ by database.
fix: Confirm the active database and schema; inspect table names; check migrations and permissions; qualify the table with its schema when appropriate; test with a minimal SELECT. Do not modify or drop production tables to experiment.

title: Python index out of range
symptoms: IndexError list index out of range list index sequence array empty list
cause: Code accessed a sequence index that does not exist, often because the collection is empty, a loop boundary is incorrect, or an index is calculated from the wrong length.
fix: Inspect the collection length immediately before access; check empty-input handling; review range bounds and off-by-one conditions; prefer iteration over manual indexing when appropriate; add tests for empty and one-element inputs.

title: Python indentation error alternative checks
symptoms: SyntaxError invalid syntax unexpected token expected colon missing parenthesis python parser
cause: The parser encountered malformed syntax such as a missing colon, bracket, quote, or operator, possibly on the previous line.
fix: Read the full traceback and inspect the reported line plus the line above it; match brackets and quotes; check colons after compound statements; run python -m py_compile your_file.py.

title: Connection timeout or refused
symptoms: ConnectionError timeout connection refused server unreachable DNS network port
cause: The target service may be down, the hostname or port may be incorrect, a firewall may block traffic, or the client timeout may be too short for the operation.
fix: Verify the hostname and port; confirm the service is running; test connectivity in a safe environment; inspect service logs; distinguish DNS, refused connection, and timeout errors. Avoid disabling security controls as a first response.

title: Java cannot find symbol
symptoms: cannot find symbol Java compile error method variable class unresolved symbol
cause: A variable, method, or class may be misspelled, out of scope, missing an import, or absent from the configured dependency/classpath.
fix: Read the compiler's symbol and location; check spelling and capitalization; confirm declaration and scope; add the correct import or dependency if appropriate; rebuild after checking the project's build configuration.

title: Python type mismatch
symptoms: TypeError unsupported operand type can only concatenate str not int object is not callable
cause: An operation received a value of an unexpected type, or a variable name may have overwritten a function or built-in.
fix: Inspect the full error and operand types near the failing line; validate external inputs; convert values explicitly only when semantically correct; check for names that shadow functions; add a minimal regression test.
